title.narrative: ICMPS NEW GUINEA BINATANG RESEARCH CENTRE V034 CANBERRA

description.narrative: We seek to improve environmental expertise in PNG, elevating the role of women in the sector, and ultimately creating future leaders in the fight against climate change and social inequality.BRC, in close partnership with Wanang Conservation Area (WCA), will deliver a 15 day training course for 20 junior biologists. The first phase (10 days) takes place in WCA and will include guided forest trips in the vicinity of the Wanang field station with explanations of various ecological phenomena, including forest succession, and visits to ongoing ecological experiments on forest regeneration. The main field component will revolve around trainee practical research experience. Each team will work with course instructors to implement their mini-project, applying what they learn from the course program. This program includes surveys of plants in plots (establishing their own plots), insects by sweep net, light trap, pitfall and malaise trapping, birds by mist-netting and point counts, amphibians by night visual and vocal surveys, and mammals by audio surveys and mist netting (bats), statistical analysis workshops, together with lectures on forest ecology and experimental design.
